item.title: ‘Limited access’ to specialist dementia nurses at end of life, report finds
item.description: A dementia charity has called for expanded access to specialist dementia nurses after a survey revealed people are left without support

item.title: Fitness to practise dashboard launched by NMC to highlight midwifery cases
item.description: The nursing regulator has launched a new interactive dashboard to provide data about midwifery fitness to practise (FtP) cases.

item.title: MenB vaccination offer expanded to include some year 11 pupils in Kent
item.description: Meningitis vaccinations will be offered to Year 11 students across four Kent schools, the UK Health and Security Agency (UKHSA) has said.

item.description: How to step up asthma treatment in a child who can't use a dry powder inhaler (DPI) licensed for Maintenance and Reliever Therapy (MART)

item.title: Digital badge no longer mandatory for advanced practice nurses under ARRS
item.description: An NHS accreditation scheme that has been criticised as a barrier to employment for advanced practice nurses in general practice will no longer be a mandatory requirement for recruitment under the additional roles reimbursement scheme (ARRS).

item.description: Two GLP-1 medications, semaglutide and – to a lesser extent – liraglutide, were shown to be effective in reducing the risk of worsening mental illness in people who also have diabetes, a large Swedish study has found. item.title: Funding for ARRS nurse roles outlined for 2026/27
